verification_candidates.claim_text: Plants make chemicals such as tannins and oxalates to defend themselves, and those chemicals are bad for humans.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The thinking here is that plants make chemicals to defend themselves against diseases or getting eaten by bugs
verification_candidates.rationale: Central claim of the plant-toxicity narrative that the episode later debunks; whether plant defense chemicals harm humans is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Anti-nutrients in plant foods can interfere with absorbing certain nutrients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: They can interfere with us absorbing certain nutrients
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable physiological claim about anti-nutrients underlying the plant-toxicity debate.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Most anti-nutrients in plant foods either break down when cooked, are present in very small doses, or do not matter much as long as people eat a generally healthy, varied diet.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most of these things either break down when they're cooked, or they're they're in very small doses, or they just don't matter that much
verification_candidates.rationale: The key rebuttal to the claim that plant toxins are a health hazard; the dose and cooking claims can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Some people may be uniquely sensitive to chemicals in plant foods, with guts reactive to things in plants.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Some people are uniquely sensitive to these chemicals
verification_candidates.rationale: The individual-sensitivity claim shapes whether avoiding plant foods is warranted.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In a case series, people with IBD who switched to a vegan diet had their IBD clear up.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I also found a case series where people with IBD switched to a vegan diet, literally the opposite, all plants, and their IBD cleared up too
verification_candidates.rationale: A cited case-series outcome that bears on whether plant foods are harmful for IBD.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is probably no one IBD diet that heals all cases.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Yeah, there's probably no one IBD diet to heal them all
verification_candidates.rationale: A testable claim about the existence of a universal IBD diet.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet cures arthritis, psoriasis, and a lot of autoimmune conditions.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: people talk about stuff like the carnivore diet curing arthritis, psoriasis, a lot of autoimmune stuff, actually
verification_candidates.rationale: A widely circulated treatment claim about the carnivore diet, reported and later questioned.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet helps people with brain fog.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And people will also say it helps them with brain fog
verification_candidates.rationale: A reported benefit claim tied to the carnivore-cures narrative.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet works as an elimination diet for people uniquely sensitive to something in plants.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And this diet functions basically as an elimination diet for these issues
verification_candidates.rationale: The mechanism offered to explain reported carnivore-diet benefits.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The carnivore diet is a ketogenic diet.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The carnivore diet is also a ketogenic diet
